description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, a component that constructs responses and events for the modify feature properties command in a live scenario within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses mock objects and assertions to validate various response types and error handling.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the builder implementation that creates responses and events for modify feature properties commands.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock command object with test constants and creates an instance of the builder to be tested.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Verifies that passing null to the factory method throws a NullPointerException with an appropriate message.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithModifyFeaturePropertiesCreatedResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests creation of a response indicating that feature properties have been created successfully.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithModifyFeaturePropertiesModifiedResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests creation of a response indicating that feature properties have been modified successfully.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests that the builder correctly constructs an error response for inaccessible feature properties.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesNotModifiableErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests that the builder creates an error response when feature properties are not modifiable.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesCreatedEventOnly
methods.description: Tests creation of an event indicating feature properties were created.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesModifiedEventOnly
methods.description: Tests creation of an event indicating feature properties were modified.
